title: Category Engagement Saturation
scenario: Identify the top 3 categories by comment density (comments per article) for each month.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, category_id INT, publish_date DATE), comments (comment_id INT, article_id INT, comment_date TIMESTAMP)
correctQuery: SELECT mon, category_id FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', c.comment_date) as mon, a.category_id, COUNT(c.comment_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT a.article_id) as density, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', c.comment_date) ORDER BY COUNT(c.comment_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT a.article_id) DESC) as rnk FROM articles a JOIN comments c ON a.article_id = c.article_id GROUP BY mon, a.category_id) t WHERE rnk <= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, category_id INT, publish_date DATE); CREATE TABLE comments (comment_id INT, article_id INT, comment_date TIMESTAMP);
